q1_products_inward_of_w010.answer: No official mesh, segment, strip, or 2-D ink prediction covers w000-w009 on either 20260411134726 or 20260608103018. The dense volume-wide 3-D products (surface predictions, lasagna, fibers, 3-D ink) span the whole 2.4 um volume and have non-trivial chunks written at the umbilicus, so they do cover the core, but they are volumes, not a traced sheet.

q2_area_w000_009.method: Per 10 mm z bin of the 20260701 w010-027 2.4 um mesh: r_in = p5 of vertex radius (proxy for w010), r_med = p50. Model windings k=0..9 as r_k = r_in*(k+0.5)/10.5 (innermost wraps umbilicus, uniform pitch inside w010). Area = tau * sum_z 2*pi*dz*sum_k r_k, with tortuosity tau calibrated so that 18 windings at r_med reproduce the mesh area of w010-027. Range: r_k proportional to k (low) or k+1 (high).
q2_area_w000_009.abs_winding_check: abs_winding.json gives r(w) ~ 0.222 mm/winding * w - 0.43 mm over w10-63 (59 pts, mostly one z); w010 at r=1.46 mm, z=153 mm. Mesh gives w010-027 p5 r = 0.70-1.62 mm per z bin. So w000-009 lie within r ~0.7-1.6 mm of the umbilicus: implied inner pitch ~0.07-0.15 mm (30-65 vox at 2.4 um, 60-140 vox at 1.129 um), tighter than the ~0.22 mm pitch outside. Possibly compressed or damaged core; unverified.
q2_area_w000_009.summary: w000-w009 total ~66-80 cm2 over z 28.7-172.9 mm (~58 cm2 inside the written region z 38.4-163.2 mm); w004-009 alone ~84% of that (~55-67 cm2 full z).

inside_1129_footprint.answer: Partly. In x,y the umbilicus stays >= 3.9 mm inside the 1.129 um footprint over its z range, so the whole r < 1.6 mm core is in x,y. In z the footprint covers only 67.4-135.3 mm, i.e. ~54% of the written region. Inner area inside the footprint ~29-31 cm2.

tracing.official_whole_scroll_tool: villa/spiral-fitting fit_spiral.py. Tutorial: 'You'll need Python >= 3.14 and an NVIDIA GPU'; the dataset is ~90 GB. Not runnable in a 4-CPU no-GPU container.
tracing.cpu_alternative: VC3D (volume-cartographer) patch growth (GrowPatch / vc_grow_seg_from_seed) seeded at w010's inner edge on the surface_m7 L2 prediction, with lasagna cos/nx/ny + fibers as guides. VC3D binaries are not installed in this container (which vc_render_tifxyz: none); a build is needed.

q4_official_statements.quote: The expected title region has shown no detectable ink so far — possibly a different ink, and the top rows are physically missing — so finding it may take better methods, higher resolution, or looking somewhere new.
The title often follows the end of the primary text, in a subsequent column that can be otherwise blank. When the final column of the primary text is short, it may also appear below this last column.
We know from the opened ones that Herculaneum scrolls often contain a final title at the end of the roll.

q4_official_statements.note: No official page gives a winding number, radius, segment id or coordinates for the title region, nor states whether it lies inward of w010. 'Inward of the end of the text' is the orchestrator's/DECL-P4-2 derivation, not an organizer statement.

gaps: Chunk HEAD sizes show non-constant content, not that sheets are resolved in the core; contents not read.
The p5 radius is a proxy for w010; per-vertex winding labels were not available.
Inner pitch 0.07-0.15 mm is inferred, not measured; the core may be crushed, so w000-009 may not be traceable at 2.4 um.
The 2.4 um ResNet-152 CPU cost is an estimate, not a benchmark.
abs_winding points cluster at one z (~150 mm); r(w) fit is local.
